basic_info.description: Located on a picturesque tree-lined street at the intersection of Glen Park & Noe Valley, this top-flr Edwardian condo offers the perfect blend of classic San Francisco charm & modern convenience. Part of an intimate 2-unit bldg, it offers 2 spacious bedrooms w/ ample closet space & 1 full bath in a serene urban setting.  The spacious living room, w/ its cozy fireplace & large bay windows, fills the space w/ natural light & offers views of downtown SF, the Bay bridge & Bernal Heights. Original crown molding & period details enhance the home's character, while the newly remodeled kitchen features plenty of cabinet space & SS appliances, including a Bertazzoni 5-burner range, ensuring a top-tier cooking experience.  The updated bathroom includes the convenience of an in-unit Miele w/d.  Step outside to a pvt shared yard, shaded by mature trees & lush greenery, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Addt'l features include a large attic space, an expansive storage room & a shared garage.  Just a short walk from the vibrant shops, grocery store & restaurants on Church St, Sanchez slow street, the J-church & close to the Upper Noe Rec Center, which offers playgrounds, basketball courts, & more, This home exemplifies quintessential San Francisco living in a tight-knit community.
